run_pyproject_linter_cli: run the pyproject linter CLI to check consistency of one or more pyproject.toml files
run_check_file: run check_file on a pyproject.toml path to validate requires-python and classifiers consistency
run_format_error_message: run format_error_message to create a LintMessage for a given filename and error or message
review_LintSeverity: review the LintSeverity enum to understand error, warning, advice, and disabled severity levels
review_LintMessage: review the LintMessage NamedTuple to understand the structure of lint result fields
